_editing_note: The seven Common Facility Centre cluster projects. `x` and `y` place the cluster on the Marathwada schematic (0-100 each, left-to-right and top-to-bottom) — nudge them only if the map looks wrong. `facilities` is the machinery list from the old site.
intro: Clusters pool what a single small unit cannot afford alone: a Common Facility Centre with machinery, testing and training that its members share.
_schemeValue_note: The old site cited the ₹5 Cr MSE-CDP scheme for the steel furniture, truck body building and garment clusters specifically.

clusters.name: Auto Component Cluster
clusters.summary: Aurangabad's industrial area has become a major hub for auto component manufacturing, supplying almost all the major global OEMs.
problem: Ancillary units have the capacity and already supply most major OEMs of global automobile companies.
Individual units struggle to stay in global competition for want of modern technology.
clusters.purpose: Establish a Common Facility Centre in Chikalthana industrial area so engineering units across Marathwada can use specialised hi-tech facilities at optimum cost.
facilities: Precision machining — VMC, turn mill, CNC lathe
Sheet metal and tube working — water jet, 5-axis pipe bending, CNC sheet bending
IT infrastructure with a CAD-CAM and CAE design centre
Training and education, meeting and office space, auditorium and exhibition halls

clusters.name: Steel Furniture Cluster
clusters.summary: Fabricators around Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar and Latur build furniture to order, but without formal training or modern machinery they cannot meet bulk orders on time.
problem: No formal or professional training, and no state-of-the-art machinery, so growing expectations on availability and cost go unmet.
Considerable scope for improvement in finish and aesthetic quality.
Market is being lost to traders importing Chinese furniture at lower cost.
clusters.purpose: Establish a Common Facility Centre to enhance the capabilities of micro and small steel furniture units, under the government's ₹5 crore MSE-CDP scheme.
facilities: Utility services and modern hand tools

clusters.name: Paithani Cluster
clusters.summary: The Paithani sari is woven by hand from fine silk and zari in the town of Paithan, and is among the richest saris in Maharashtra.
problem: A plain weave with weft figuring worked on tapestry principles — a heritage silk handloom craft.
Highly skilled women weavers remain poor despite the value of what they make.
clusters.purpose: Establish a Common Facility Centre to transform highly skilled women weavers into entrepreneurs, revive the handloom silk weaving art and take it to a global level, and make weaving a good source of earning.

clusters.name: Garment Cluster
clusters.summary: Stitching has long been a traditional skill of rural women. Forty women in Pimpalner have already trained and want to turn it into a profession.
problem: Forty women in Pimpalner village near Beed have shown keen interest in developing this work.
They have already taken basic tailoring training at Late Shobhatai Satishrao Patil Mahila Vyavasayik Prashikshan Kendra, Pimpalner.
With a Common Facility Centre, 20% growth a year is achievable.
clusters.purpose: Establish a Common Facility Centre to enhance the capabilities of garment units in and around Pimpalner (Beed), under the government's MSE-CDP scheme.
facilities: Centre of Excellence building with quality checking

clusters.name: Truck Body Building Cluster
clusters.summary: What began as a few small fabrication units in Madalmohi grew into the region's centre for truck body building — now 40+ units putting out around 200 new bodies a year.
problem: A few people in Madalmohi started small fabrication units and acquired the skill of truck body repair, then complete body building.
An ecosystem developed as others joined, and the village became a popular centre for the trade in the region.
There are now 40+ units building around 200 new truck bodies a year, alongside continuous repair and renovation work.
clusters.purpose: Establish a Common Facility Centre to enhance the capabilities of micro and small truck body building units in and around Madalmohi, under the government's ₹5 crore MSE-CDP scheme.
facilities: Centre of Excellence building with product and process development
Saw mill and round / square drill machine

clusters.name: Bakery Cluster
clusters.summary: Bakery owners around Daulatabad have the skill but not the hygiene processes or variety to hold their market against corporate producers.
problem: Bakery unit owners in and around Daulatabad have developed the skill of preparing products to order.
Expectations around hygienic processes have risen, and there is wide scope for improvement in quality and variety.
Market potential is being lost to corporate bakery producers.
Because bakery products are preferred fresh, local units can capture up to 80% of the local market.
clusters.purpose: Establish a Common Facility Centre to enhance the capabilities of micro bakery units in and around Daulatabad, under the government's MSE-CDP scheme.
facilities: Centre of Excellence building with quality checking
Raw material bank and cold storage

clusters.name: Tiny General Engineering & Allied Industries Cluster
clusters.summary: A cooperative of first-generation entrepreneurs built 60 micro galas for allied manufacturing. Seventeen years on, space and old technology are holding them back.
problem: A group of first-generation young entrepreneurs formed a Tiny Industrial Cooperative Society and created 60 micro galas for allied manufacturing.
Technology and the business scenario have changed considerably since.
Space constraints and slow technology adoption now hold these units back even as their market grows several fold.
